paragraphs.text: Sparrow Hawk , called Hawk in adulthood, was a human from North Aerona on Dominaria . He was the younger brother of Gull and Greensleeves .

Sparrow Hawk had tousled red hair and a freckled nose. He had his mother's impish sense of humor. After being enchanted by Towser , he was over seven feet tall and heavily muscled. He wore a black-and-red-striped kilt, a leather war harness, and tall boots, with red leather armbands. Over his head, he wore an iron helmet with thin ruby plates in its eye sockets, intricate fangs over his mouth, and curved horns stylized after a reindeer's. He carried an over six-foot-long two-handed sword. He rode a mutated horse, deep roan colored, with a stiff, scraggly mane and forward-facing horns like a bull's.

Sparrow Hawk lived peacefully with his brother and sister and his younger brother in the village of White Ridge , on the border of the Whispering Woods . Greensleeves was perceived to be dim-witted because she couldn't talk, but only chattered like an animal. One day, a falling star was seen in the sky, which was reputed to be a bad omen. This was proven true when White Ridge was destroyed a month later during a wizard's duel. Sparrow Hawk was separated from his family during the destruction of White Ridge .

Unbeknownst to his siblings, Sparrow Hawk was captured by Towser . Seeking a tool against Gull and Greensleeves, Towser sent him to Keld , having him trained in a collapsed-time spell, infused with magic, and enchanted into the form of a warlord. The wizard corrupted his mind, turning him against his family.

Meanwhile, Gull and Greensleeves, who turned out to be a planeswalker , formed an army and liberated almost all of North Aerona from rampaging wizards. Ten wizards under the leadership of Towser and Karli regrouped on Towser's tropical island , protecting themselves from Greensleeves's magic by wearing Nova Pentacles . Aided by their newly minted Keldon Warlord, they attacked the army from three different directions. Gull confronted the warlord and was almost killed before Greensleeves could teleport him away. After traveling to Lat-Nam to discover the secret of the Stone Brain , Gull and Greensleeves were attacked once again by Towser's wizards. After a long battle, the army retreated into a tunnel, where Gull had a dream about his dead family. Among them, he didn't see Sparrow Hawk, their long-lost brother, and thus, he had a revelation of the warlord's identity.

Gull revealed to the Keldon that the latter was, in truth, Sparrow Hawk, and the two brothers reconciled. However, the wizard Haakon unleashed a fireball against the two. This caused Greensleeves to go mad with anger and sorrow, making the "final sacrifice" of her ideal that every life was sacred. She became a godlike being and lost herself, seeing her friends and family as mere ants compared to her. Before she could unleash her overwhelming power and destroy the isle, though, she was brought to her senses by her lover Kwam and saw that her brothers had survived the fireball, thanks to the enchanted might of Sparrow Hawk. Greensleeves decided to pour all of her mana into the Isle of Lat-Nam, curing the land of the poison and transforming the desert into a verdant forest, in the process sacrificing her planeswalker powers.
In the aftermath of the Battle of Lat-Nam , Greensleeves was declared High Wizard of the Domains by her followers. Thereafter, she and her brothers disappeared from history.
